summary: Learn sustainable tourism practices with our comprehensive training. Learn to develop eco-friendly strategies that benefit communities and the environment.
lede: Sustainable tourism planning and communication turns sustainability goals into destination actions that can be monitored and reported. Designed for tourism planners, destination managers, resort leaders, and public-sector officers, the course covers impact and carrying-capacity assessment, stakeholder engagement, and KPI tracking for sustainability reporting. Learners also practise developing sustainable destination action plans and governance matrices.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who influence tourism planning, destination operations, and sustainability reporting across public, private, and community settings.
prerequisites: You should bring familiarity with tourism, hospitality, destination planning, or community development. A laptop is recommended for workbook exercises, and you will benefit from using spreadsheet software for calculations, templates, and dashboard practice.
